iq-moc-price-20260903.account: Iraq Ministry of Communications / Mustafa Sanad
iq-moc-price-20260903.title: Internet prices for government entities cut by 40%, with tower speeds raised by about 40%
iq-moc-price-20260903.summary: The Ministry of Communications announced lower internet prices for government entities while increasing wireless-tower service capacity.
iq-moc-price-20260903.impact: Budgets for government connectivity and cloud links may be reallocated. Track new bandwidth procurements by ITPC, the ministry and major public-sector customers.

iq-cmc-korek-20260831.title: CMC closes Korek's Karbala headquarters as enforcement intensifies
iq-cmc-korek-20260831.summary: CMC's local office, working with national security and intelligence bodies, carried out the closure, showing that regulatory decisions against Korek have moved into physical enforcement.
iq-cmc-korek-20260831.impact: Korek's network expansion, payments and procurement decisions now carry materially higher risk. Opportunities involving Korek require tighter licensing and payment-condition checks.

iq-cmc-court-20260826.title: Court lifts Korek's interim injunction while CMC's suspension decision remains in force
iq-cmc-court-20260826.summary: The Rusafa Court of First Instance lifted Korek's interim injunction and left CMC's decision to suspend dealings with the company in effect.
iq-cmc-court-20260826.impact: Regulatory uncertainty has become a defined judicial and enforcement risk. Network, channel and service contracts involving Korek need elevated compliance review.

iq-cmc-type-approval-20260824.title: CMC and Samsung explore an electronic type-approval platform
iq-cmc-type-approval-20260824.summary: The parties discussed device entry procedures, certification fees and technical standards, as well as an automated platform for equipment type approval.
iq-cmc-type-approval-20260824.impact: This is a direct opportunity in digital market access, including platform software, testing laboratories, data governance and systems integration.

iq-cmc-ai-20260825.title: CMC and Zain Iraq launch a six-month AI capability programme
iq-cmc-ai-20260825.summary: The programme covers AI governance, data analytics and practical applications, with CMC incorporating AI capability into institutional talent development.
iq-cmc-ai-20260825.impact: The near-term opportunity is training and advisory work; the medium-term opportunity may extend to regulatory data platforms, intelligent analytics and automated network supervision.
